details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which sends an HTTP POST to hxxp://185[.]158[.]107[.]175:8787/_ah/dc with the header x-beacon-package and a JSON body containing the package name, the machine hostname, the install directory, the working directory, and the npm/node version. The same beacon is also sent when the package's index.js is required, and index.js exports a no-op Proxy so that imports of the real package's members do not fail. No credentials, environment values, tokens, wallet data or file contents are collected or transmitted; the only data sent is install-time host metadata.
